start: Members screen, All members tab, gym with members

steps.action: Tap "+ Add member"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Add member"
Empty "Full name" box in focus, placeholder "Riya Sharma"
"Code" set to the gym default, "Mobile number" with hint "Used to find them, and to send them WhatsApp messages."

Joining date empty or on another day than today

must_not: The country code typed twice into the number
An error shown while the person is still typing

steps.action: Tap "Add member"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…" and cannot be pressed again
The sheet closes and the new member's page opens
must_not: Two members made from one tap

start: Members screen with no member yet, or the address /members/new

steps.action: Tap "+ Add member" on the empty list (or open the address /members/new)
user_sees: Sheet titled "Add member" open straight away, boxes empty
must_not: A name or number left over from an earlier add
The list behind missing while the sheet is open

steps.action: Fill name, mobile, gender, date of birth, email, address, emergency contact, emergency number and notes, then tap "Add member"
user_sees: The sheet closes and the new member's page opens with the details typed
must_not: An optional detail dropped on save
The emergency number saved in a form that cannot be called

start: Add member sheet open

steps.action: Leave Full name and Mobile number empty, type "abc" as email, pick a date of birth after today, tap "Add member"
user_sees: Under Full name: "Type the member’s name."
Under Mobile number: "Type their mobile number."
Under Email: "That email address doesn’t look right."
Under Date of birth: "Date of birth can’t be in the future."
The first wrong box is scrolled into view and takes focus
must_not: Only one wrong box named per press
A member saved
The sheet closing

steps.action: Type a 5-digit mobile number and tap "Add member"
user_sees: Under Mobile number: "This mobile number looks wrong. Check it and type it again."
must_not: A member saved with a short number

steps.action: Type a name of 81 letters and tap "Add member"
user_sees: Under Full name: "The name can be at most 80 letters."
must_not: The name cut to 80 letters and saved without a word

start: Add member sheet open with a name and number typed

steps.action: Tap "Cancel" (or press Escape)
user_sees: The sheet closes; the Members list is unchanged
must_not: A member saved

steps.action: Tap "+ Add member" again
user_sees: An empty form: no name, no number, joining date today
must_not: The values typed before the cancel shown again as if saved

start: Add member sheet open

steps.action: Fill mobile, date of birth, address, emergency contact and notes, then tap "Add member"
user_sees: Hint under Mobile number: "Used to find them, and to send them WhatsApp messages."
The member's page with these details
must_not: A WhatsApp, SMS or email sent to the new member by the save itself
The details shown to another gym

note: Name is capped at 80 letters with a message; address and notes have no cap in the form

Long sheet with a footer; Code and Mobile number share one row
Typed values live only in the open sheet; a reload for a new panel version empties it
A member added on the phone must reach the laptop; an app member with the same mobile should line up with this row

title: With "Comes with a pass" ticked and no company picked, "Add member" can look as if it does nothing
what: When the pass box is ticked and no company chip is picked, pressing Add member (or Save changes) saves nothing and writes "Pick or type the pass company." under the chips. Every other wrong box is scrolled into view, but this message is not, because the chips are not marked as a wrong box. The pass part sits near the top of a long form and the button is at the bottom, so on a phone the message is off the screen and the button seems dead.
expected: The pass company message is brought into view like every other wrong box, so the desk sees why nothing was saved.
who: owners and front-desk staff adding a pass member
how_often: each time the pass box is ticked, no company is picked and the form is scrolled down
fix_line: Scroll to the pass company message when it is the reason nothing was saved
